questions.question: How should this subagent drive Playwright? There's no Playwright MCP server currently configured in this repo.

options.label: Playwright MCP server
options.description: Agent uses @playwright/mcp tools (browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, browser_click...). I'd also add the MCP server config. Best for interactive, exploratory testing where the agent observes and reacts to the live page.

options.label: Bash + Playwright scripts
options.description: Agent writes and runs Playwright test scripts via Bash (npx playwright). Best for repeatable, committed test suites.

questions.question: What mobile screen size should the browser always open at?

options.label: iPhone (390×844)
options.description: iPhone 12/13/14 logical viewport, DPR 3. A common modern mobile baseline.

options.label: iPhone SE (375×667)
options.description: Smaller iPhone viewport — good for testing tight layouts.

answers.How should this subagent drive Playwrigh: create a .claude agent and set up the mcp only for this sub agent
